questions.title: Which circuit will Formula One announce as the replacement venue for the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix?
questions.background: The Bahrain Grand Prix originally scheduled for April 2026 was cancelled amid conflict in the Middle East.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Formula One's first official announcement after May 1, 2026 identifying a replacement host circuit for the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix. Resolution Conditions : The announcement must occur by December 31, 2026. Resolution is based on the announced venue, regardless of whether the race is subsequently held or receives final regulatory approval. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the circuit.

local_articles.title: Aston Martin hope Hungary upgrade puts them 'back in the game'
local_articles.snippet: BUDAPEST, July 23 - Struggling Aston Martin hope a new chassis puts them 'back in the game' at the Hungarian Grand Prix this weekend, chief trackside officer Mike Krack said on Thursday while also trying to manage expectations. Honda-powered Aston are 10th of 11 teams in the Formula One constructors' standings with one point from 10 rounds so far. The team that finished fifth in 2023 and 2024, and seventh last year, have been woefully uncompetitive in the first year of their partnership with Honda and despite having top F1 designer and serial title-winner Adrian Newey at the helm. The cars brought to Hungary have a new chassis with significant aerodynamic upgrades and weight reduction. The gearbox remains unchanged and a more powerful Honda engine will come for the following Dutch Grand Prix in Zandvoort at the end of August. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the destination club in the first such agreement announced between June 1 and August 31, 2026. Loan agreements do not count. local_articles.snippet: Over coffee in Liverpool’s plush hotel in Chicago, Andoni Iraola presents his theory for the phenomenal success of Basque and Spanish coaches. It is a theory that will shape his entire approach to life as the Liverpool head coach and his attempts to bring the connection, the joy and the belief back to Anfield. It centres on the power of the collective. The Champions League, the Premier League, the Europa League, the FA Cup, the League Cup, the European Championship and, as of Sunday, the World Cup: all currently in the hands of Basque and Spanish coaches, even if Pep Guardiola has since taken his leave from Manchester City. Next season, four men from the small Basque region of Gipuzkoa will manage four of the Premier League’s main contenders, Iraola included, alongside Mikel Arteta, Xabi Alonso and Unai Emery. questions.title: Who will be appointed Peru's foreign minister in the incoming presidential administration's first cabinet in July 2026?
questions.background: A new presidential administration is scheduled to take office in Peru in July 2026. Its foreign minister will oversee the country's diplomatic relations.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Peruvian government announcements or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the person officially appointed minister of foreign affairs in the incoming administration's first cabinet, with the appointment announced by July 31, 2026. Speculation about potential appointments does not count. Accepted Answer Format : The appointed foreign minister's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Major 2026-07-13 to 2026-07-15 Peruvian transition breakthrough across El Comercio, Infobae, Gestion, and Gato Encerrado: former 2026 presidential candidate and Sí Creo party leader Carlos Espá has emerged as the clear frontrunner to become Keiko Fujimori's Foreign Minister. Crucially, El Comercio (July 14) reveals that Carla Mares Ruiz—previously accredited to Fujimori's Foreign Ministry transition team (ETTE) at Torre Tagle—was Sí Creo's Senate candidate alongside her former Universidad del Pacífico student president Giacomo Sanguinetti Ravettino, providing strong structural evidence that Torre Tagle is being lined up for Espá. Espá met privately with Fujimori and expected incoming Premier Luis Galarreta on July 13, declined to deny Canciller reports ('hay que tener paciencia'; 'dispuestos a poner nuestro granito de arena'), and Gato Encerrado (July 15) cited a Fujimorismo insider explicitly naming Carlos Espá as incoming Foreign Minister on the same day Fujimori received her JNE credentials and announced a multipartisan ('multipartidario') first cabinet. Promoting Carlos Espá directly to #1 at a disciplined 0.45 (respecting the unconfirmed-appointment cap given potential vetting/diplomatic pushback before July 27-28), trimming career/former-FM fallbacks Javier González-Olaechea (0.12 -> 0.08), Hugo de Zela (0.11 -> 0.08), Elmer Schialer (0.07 -> 0.05), and Carlos Pareja (0.06 -> 0.04), dropping Alfredo Ferrero, and keeping 30% residual for Torre Tagle's diplomatic bench or another multipartisan appointee.

questions.title: Who will be the first West Indies bowler to take a five-wicket haul in the opening Test against Pakistan in Tarouba in July 2026?
questions.background: A five-wicket haul means that a bowler takes at least five wickets in a single innings.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the first West Indies bowler to reach five wickets in a single innings during the opening Test against Pakistan in Tarouba in July 2026, according to the match scorecard and contemporaneous match reporting. Resolution Date : 2026-07-27 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the bowler's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: The opening Test at Brian Lara Cricket Academy in Tarouba (July 25-29) will be the venue's maiden Test match, expected to offer seam movement and variable bounce. West Indies' June 16 Test squad for Sri Lanka confirms CWI's managed pace trio of Jayden Seales (Trinidad home bowler and WI's most reliable strike seamer), Shamar Joseph (51 Test wickets at 21.67, returning from shoulder injury), and Alzarri Joseph (returning from back injury), alongside vice-captain and sole specialist spinner Jomel Warrican (19 wickets vs Pakistan in 2025) and veteran Kemar Roach. Conditional on a West Indies bowler claiming a five-for, Seales (29%) and Shamar Joseph (27%) lead as primary new-ball/strike threats, with 10% left for Roston Chase, Anderson Phillip, Justin Greaves, or a recalled Gudakesh Motie.
